% PGF manual decorations.text: finite and path-filling repeat text.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.text}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[help lines] (0,-0.5) grid (8,3.5);
  \draw[gray,dashed] (0,3) -- (8,3);
  \path[decorate,decoration={text effects along path,text={AB },raise=2pt,
    text effects/.cd,repeat text}]
    (0,3) -- (8,3);
  \draw[gray,dashed] (0,1.75) -- (8,1.75);
  \path[decorate,decoration={text effects along path,text={AB\ },raise=2pt,
    text effects/.cd,repeat text}]
    (0,1.75) -- (8,1.75);
  \draw[gray,dashed] (0,0.5) -- (8,0.5);
  \path[decorate,decoration={text effects along path,text={WXY},raise=2pt,
    text effects/.cd,repeat text=1}]
    (0,0.5) -- (8,0.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
